title: Roasted Vegetable Tart
description: A savory tart filled with roasted vegetables and topped with a crumbly crust.

ingredients.name: roasted vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as sweet potatoes and carrots

ingredients.name: nasty kale
ingredients.amount: 1 cup, stems removed and discarded, leaves chopped

instructions: Roll out puff pastry and place on a baking sheet.
Top with roasted vegetables, kale, and diced tomato.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until pastry is golden brown.
Remove from oven and top with crumble.
Return to oven and bake for an additional 5-10 minutes or until crumble is golden brown.
Remove from oven and let cool for 10 minutes before serving.
